attributes.during:
Your ship is anchored at the Merchant Marina.
When you encounter a Sentinel Devil, succeed at a Wisdom or Perception 10 check or the Sentinel Devil may not be evaded. 
When you defeat a henchman, place it in a henchman pile next to this card. If Isawyn the Diva would be defeated, and this pile does not contain Lady Nightshade and Gorebeard Trench, Isawyn is undefeated.
